page.notes: Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words and letters marked [?] are doubtful readings, and the Greek of the Plutarch and Polybius passages should be checked against the original. "larnato" in the Plautus citation is doubtful and may be a printing error. Verse lines are set as separate paragraphs. "Virgilius," and "Seruius;" are attributions beside the verse.
